// Read-only observer compiled only into the temporary reference overlay.
package logopt
import("fmt";"cmd/internal/obj")
func SyncgoLoopRows(link *obj.Link)[]string{
 var out []string
 for _,e:=range loggedOpts{out=append(out,fmt.Sprintf("event:%v:%v:%s:%s:%s:%v",link.PosTable.Pos(e.pos),link.PosTable.Pos(e.lastPos),e.compilerPass,e.functionName,e.what,e.target))}
 return out
}
